dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave curvature on the trailing edge transitioning from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape with a moderate pixel radius at the maximum vertical extent.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree incline relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Ratio of approximately 1.3:1 base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Pronounced convex arc with a smooth, consistent radius along the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thickened rostrum with a low length-to-width pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the intersection of the melon's descending slope and the rostrum's base.

other_distinctive_markers: Monochromatic cyan coloration with synthetic surface shading and low-polygon artifacting.
